_readme: Update manifest for the Virtual Slaps games. Served as a static file from
https://virtualslaps.com/version.json (Vite copies public/ to the site root).
Each game's in-app check compares its installed versionCode against
latestVersionCode below. Raise a value ONLY AFTER that version is live in
Play production, or players will be nudged toward a build they cannot get.
message: optional one-line text shown in the banner. Keep it under ~40 chars.
Leave empty to use the default wording.
_TESTING: TEMPORARY — all three games set to a fake code to verify the update banner. Restore with ./restore-version-json.sh from the Virtual Slaps folder (staticgame 7/1.4, phasegame 2/1.1, relaygame 2/1.1) and push again.
